home.headline: Royal Softech College, Lahan
home.summary: A private college on the East-West Highway in Lahan, Siraha, offering NEB-affiliated +2 and university bachelor's programmes since 2068 BS.

programmes.name: +2 Programmes
programmes.summary: Grade 11 and 12 under the National Examinations Board, with streams in Science, Management and Computer Science.

programmes.name: Bachelor's Degrees
programmes.summary: Four-year bachelor's degrees in business studies, IT education and science, affiliated with Purbanchal University and Tribhuvan University.

admission.intro: Admission runs in five steps, from your first enquiry to the start of classes.

steps.title: Enquiry and counselling
steps.body: Visit the admission desk or call the college office to discuss the programme that fits you.

steps.title: Check eligibility
steps.body: +2 needs an SEE (or equivalent) result meeting the programme's GPA and subject requirements. Bachelor's needs +2 or equivalent in a relevant stream.

steps.title: Submit your application
steps.body: Apply with your transcripts, character certificate, recent photographs and a copy of your citizenship.

steps.title: Selection
steps.body: Applications are reviewed on merit under the board's or university's own rules; some programmes include a short interview.

steps.title: Enrol
steps.body: Complete the fee formalities and attend orientation to confirm your subjects and class schedule.

scholarships.intro: Royal Softech offers merit- and need-based support to students who qualify.

items.title: Merit scholarship
items.body: Awarded to top-ranking students in the entrance and board examinations.

items.title: Need-based support
items.body: For students from economically weaker, Janajati and other marginalised backgrounds, including fee support for Dalit students after verification.

facilities.intro: The campus is built for both study and student life.

items.name: Science and computer laboratories
items.body: Equipped for +2 Science practicals and BSc specialisations.

items.name: Sports ground
items.body: Football, basketball, volleyball and track events.

contact.hours: Sunday to Friday, 10:00 am to 4:00 pm
